newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian teacher sacked for taping pupils' mouths.
newsitem.headline: Italian teacher sacked for taping pupils' mouths.

text.p: An Italian nursery school teacher got the sack after putting adhesive tape over the mouths of two of her four-year-old pupils.
Mirco Bolis, governor of the school in Grisignano di Zocco, northern Italy, said he found out after another child "told his mother to do what teacher does to shut up his little brother".
The teacher, Emanuela Milan, denied using unorthodox discipline.
"I did it...for just a minute to show the children what silence is," she told La Stampa newspaper. "They understood it was just a game".
Milan, 33, has taken her case to a labour tribunal.
